name: Roast duck
summary: Roast duck is an eastern-route dish. The geopark names it with olive rice and smoked sausage. Báo Cao Bằng names the mắc mật leaf on the duck. A price is Check on arrival.
howToEat: The geopark management board, on 18 July 2025, names roast duck with olive sticky rice and smoked sausage on the eastern route, and does not name a leaf. Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names vịt quay tẩm lá mắc mật. The 3 May 2026 article names vịt quay lá mắc mật as a morning dish and a gift.
A roasting time and a price are Check on arrival.
where: The eastern route, and in town as a dish or a gift on the 3 May 2026 article. A stall hour is Check on arrival.
